lifecycle.review_note: Engineering executable-completeness gates passed for the encoded 15-package source scope. This is COMPLETE_UNREVIEWED, not clinical validation or autonomous prescribing authorization.

fact_definitions.fact_role_rationale: PET-adapted CHL decisions use current Deauville and biopsy status; generic current_response is retained for longitudinal provenance.

otherhist.label: Hodgkin histology is unresolved/outside CHL/NLPHL package route.

nlphl_observe.label: Selected asymptomatic nonbulky NLPHL: observation/active surveillance may be appropriate.

recommendation.title: Selected asymptomatic nonbulky NLPHL: observation/active surveillance may be appropriate.

nlphl_early_tx.label: Localized symptomatic/bulky NLPHL: ISRT and/or rituximab-containing therapy according to stage/site; systemic therapy for selected disease.

recommendation.title: Localized symptomatic/bulky NLPHL: ISRT and/or rituximab-containing therapy according to stage/site; systemic therapy for selected disease.

nlphl_adv.label: Advanced NLPHL: rituximab-containing systemic therapy +/- ISRT according to burden/symptoms.

recommendation.title: Advanced NLPHL: rituximab-containing systemic therapy +/- ISRT according to burden/symptoms.

nlphl_biopsy.label: Relapse biopsy shows aggressive B-cell transformation?

nlphl_transform.label: Aggressive B-cell transformation of NLPHL routes to B-cell lymphoma relapsed/refractory guideline.

nlphl_bxneg_obs.label: Suspected NLPHL relapse with negative biopsy: short-interval observation/repeat imaging.

recommendation.title: Suspected NLPHL relapse with negative biopsy: short-interval observation/repeat imaging.

nlphl_rr_obs.label: Asymptomatic nonbulky relapsed NLPHL: observe or rituximab or ISRT.

recommendation.title: Asymptomatic nonbulky relapsed NLPHL: observe or rituximab or ISRT.

nlphl_rr_tx.label: Symptomatic/bulky relapsed NLPHL: second-line systemic therapy +/- ISRT +/- HDT/ASCR; avoid repeating ASCR if already done.

recommendation.title: Symptomatic/bulky relapsed NLPHL: second-line systemic therapy +/- ISRT +/- HDT/ASCR; avoid repeating ASCR if already done.

follow.label: CHL follow-up after completion: source-defined clinical/lab surveillance and late-effects screening including thyroid/cardiovascular/secondary malignancy considerations.

recommendation.title: CHL follow-up after completion: source-defined clinical/lab surveillance and late-effects screening including thyroid/cardiovascular/secondary malignancy considerations.

preg_action.label: CHL during pregnancy: trimester/symptom-dependent multidisciplinary management; defer treatment when safe, use pregnancy-compatible therapy when necessary, then standard therapy postpartum/second trimester as source-defined.

recommendation.title: CHL during pregnancy: trimester/symptom-dependent multidisciplinary management; defer treatment when safe, use pregnancy-compatible therapy when necessary, then standard therapy postpartum/second trimester as source-defined.

special_old.label: Age >60 or unfit for intensive therapy?

older_adv.label: Older/unfit stage III-IV CHL: nivolumab-AVD x6 category 1 preferred when anthracycline candidate; BV-based or CPI-alone alternatives if not anthracycline candidate.

recommendation.title: Older/unfit stage III-IV CHL: nivolumab-AVD x6 category 1 preferred when anthracycline candidate; BV-based or CPI-alone alternatives if not anthracycline candidate.

options.label: Nivolumab or pembrolizumab
options.text: If BV contraindicated and no anthracycline.

older_early.label: Older/unfit stage I-II CHL: stage/risk-adapted A(B)VD/AVD + ISRT when anthracycline candidate; BV/CPI-based alternatives otherwise.

recommendation.title: Older/unfit stage I-II CHL: stage/risk-adapted A(B)VD/AVD + ISRT when anthracycline candidate; BV/CPI-based alternatives otherwise.

early_risk_system.label: Risk system GHSG or EORTC specified?

need_risk.label: GHSG/EORTC risk system and risk-factor inputs are required for early-stage CHL routing.

need_riskfacts.label: Early-stage risk factors remain insufficient to deterministically classify favorable vs unfavorable disease.

ghsg_fav.label: Age 18-60 Stage IA/IIA favorable by GHSG: ABVD x2 category 1 then interim PET/CT; Deauville response determines ISRT vs additional chemotherapy.

recommendation.title: Age 18-60 Stage IA/IIA favorable by GHSG: ABVD x2 category 1 then interim PET/CT; Deauville response determines ISRT vs additional chemotherapy.

eortc_fav_action.label: Age 18-60 Stage IA/IIA favorable by EORTC: ABVD x2 category 1 then PET; Deauville 1-2, 3, or 4-5 lead to distinct additional therapy.

recommendation.title: Age 18-60 Stage IA/IIA favorable by EORTC: ABVD x2 category 1 then PET; Deauville 1-2, 3, or 4-5 lead to distinct additional therapy.

early_unfav.label: Stage I-II unfavorable CHL: ABVD-based or source-listed contemporary systemic therapy with PET-adapted escalation/de-escalation and ISRT by response/risk.

recommendation.title: Stage I-II unfavorable CHL: ABVD-based or source-listed contemporary systemic therapy with PET-adapted escalation/de-escalation and ISRT by response/risk.

adv_initial.label: Stage III-IV CHL: preferred contemporary systemic regimen (nivolumab-AVD category 1/preferred in applicable adults) or other HODG-B regimen with PET-adapted management.

recommendation.title: Stage III-IV CHL: preferred contemporary systemic regimen (nivolumab-AVD category 1/preferred in applicable adults) or other HODG-B regimen with PET-adapted management.

resp_fav_good.label: Early favorable CHL with Deauville 1-3 after 2 ABVD cycles: additional therapy depends on GHSG/EORTC and Deauville score.

recommendation.title: Early favorable CHL with Deauville 1-3 after 2 ABVD cycles: additional therapy depends on GHSG/EORTC and Deauville score.

options.label: ISRT 20-30 Gy
options.text: Preferred combined modality according to risk system/score.

resp_fav45_action.label: Early favorable CHL Deauville 4-5 after 2 ABVD: continue ABVD x2 then repeat PET; Deauville 4-5 may require biopsy, with positive biopsy routing to primary refractory treatment.

recommendation.title: Early favorable CHL Deauville 4-5 after 2 ABVD: continue ABVD x2 then repeat PET; Deauville 4-5 may require biopsy, with positive biopsy routing to primary refractory treatment.

options.label: Biopsy persistent Deauville 4-5 lesion when feasible
options.text: Biopsy persistent Deauville 4-5 lesion when feasible

resp_good.label: Unfavorable/advanced CHL with favorable interim/post-treatment PET response: continue/de-escalate source-defined regimen +/- ISRT and then follow-up.

recommendation.title: Unfavorable/advanced CHL with favorable interim/post-treatment PET response: continue/de-escalate source-defined regimen +/- ISRT and then follow-up.

resp_bxneg.label: Deauville 4-5 with negative biopsy/no refractory confirmation: continue/complete source-directed therapy or consolidation RT with short-interval reassessment rather than automatically declaring refractory disease.

recommendation.title: Deauville 4-5 with negative biopsy/no refractory confirmation: continue/complete source-directed therapy or consolidation RT with short-interval reassessment rather than automatically declaring refractory disease.

options.label: Consolidation ISRT
options.text: If focal PET-positive and clinically appropriate.

need_pet.label: Current Deauville response at the relevant treatment timepoint is required.

primary_refractory.label: Primary refractory CHL or relapse <3 months and HDT/ASCR candidate: second-line systemic therapy, response assessment, then HDT/ASCR +/- ISRT if responsive.

recommendation.title: Primary refractory CHL or relapse <3 months and HDT/ASCR candidate: second-line systemic therapy, response assessment, then HDT/ASCR +/- ISRT if responsive.

rr_ge3.label: Biopsy-proven CHL relapse >=3 months and HDT/ASCR candidate: CPI-based second-line preferred if no prior CPI; response -> HDT/ASCR +/- ISRT, with selected localized relapse RT option.

recommendation.title: Biopsy-proven CHL relapse >=3 months and HDT/ASCR candidate: CPI-based second-line preferred if no prior CPI; response -> HDT/ASCR +/- ISRT, with selected localized relapse RT option.

options.label: CPI-based second-line systemic therapy
options.text: Preferred if no prior CPI exposure.

options.label: BV maintenance after HDT/ASCR
options.text: For high relapse risk and no prior BV.

rr_nonhct_cpi.label: Relapsed/refractory CHL not HDT/ASCR candidate and no rapid CPI/BV failure: CPI-containing regimen x4 then continue while deriving clinical benefit +/- ISRT.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory CHL not HDT/ASCR candidate and no rapid CPI/BV failure: CPI-containing regimen x4 then continue while deriving clinical benefit +/- ISRT.

options.label: CPI-containing regimen
options.text: Use if no prior CPI/appropriate exposure.

options.label: BV-containing regimen
options.text: If BV appropriate and no prior failure.

rr_nonhct_later.label: Relapsed/refractory CHL not HDT/ASCR candidate after rapid CPI/BV failure: subsequent non-cross-resistant systemic therapy +/- ISRT; clinical trial/center expertise strongly considered.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory CHL not HDT/ASCR candidate after rapid CPI/BV failure: subsequent non-cross-resistant systemic therapy +/- ISRT; clinical trial/center expertise strongly considered.

options.label: Subsequent systemic therapy not previously used
options.text: Subsequent systemic therapy not previously used

consistency_rules.message: Stage III-IV cannot be classified as early favorable CHL.
GHSG/EORTC CHL early-risk system should not drive NLPHL routing.
